purpose: Feasibility pilot for workflow ablation, not a full-system comparison or a superiority test. Runtime evaluator remains unchanged.

model.settings: Resolve and pin actual supported reasoning/configuration before any search; identical for all arms.

budget.token_budget: Not yet confirmed; log all usage. No model calls have been made.

arms.goal_only: A goal-only prompt baseline inspired by JustGoal. This is not a reproduction of the entire JustGoal system.
arms.ako4all_workflow_adaptation: Pinned bbd0e1cf1ce2fb19d4322a932680f4c3d175d80e workflow, adapted to the common evaluator and Codex tools. Record exact instruction/command changes before launching; do not call it the native system.
arms.kernel_envolve_skill: Current repository skill; the same evaluator and resources as other arms.

common_contract.device: One idle B300; serialize performance measurement.
common_contract.timer: Synchronized eager wall latency, including CPU launch and device completion. No CUDA Graph.
common_contract.objective: Equal-weight sum of per-case median latency; report individual cases and >5% regressions.
common_contract.dtype: FP32 inputs/outputs, independent FP64 arithmetic oracle rounded to FP32.
common_contract.precision: TF32 disabled for the original baseline; a candidate may choose its implementation but must pass the same numerical rules.
common_contract.shapes: Exactly the declared public shapes/layouts; final seeds withheld, no undisclosed out-of-domain shapes.
common_contract.resources: Identical initial code, common development evaluator, tool access and reference links; only workflow instructions differ.
common_contract.candidate_format: One candidate.py with run; installed torch/triton/CUDA compilation tools may be used. No external local helper files in this pilot. The same restriction applies to all arms.

required_before_launch: Freeze the common prompt, exact arm prompts, model configuration and version identities.
Establish independent directories/conversations and enforce no cross-arm candidate access.
Precommit final input seeds outside the agents’ accessible workspace.
Validate deadline termination, final-source freezing and resource release before starting.
final_acceptance.submission: At the deadline freeze the explicitly declared delivery; do not retrospectively choose the candidate with best final-test score.
outcomes: correct delivery count including all failures
final_acceptance.pilot_success: All nine runs terminate within budget with frozen source and complete cost/final-acceptance records. Results validate the experimental procedure, not statistical superiority.

formal_comparison: After the pilot, at least five independent runs per task/arm with prespecified practical benefit and cost criteria. Expanded model budget and final settings remain to be confirmed; no formal runs are scheduled.
